BoxStroke.Parent = KeyTextBox


local ReplayButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
ReplayButton.Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 40)
ReplayButton.Position = UDim2.new(0, 15, 1, -55)
ReplayButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 125, 255)
ReplayButton.Text = "Dupe"
ReplayButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
ReplayButton.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
ReplayButton.TextSize = 13
ReplayButton.AutoButtonColor = true
ReplayButton.Parent = MainFrame

local ButtonCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
ButtonCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
ButtonCorner.Parent = ReplayButton

local function startLoop()
    task.spawn(function()
        while _G.PetCashToggle do
            for i = 1, 30 do
                if not _G.PetCashToggle then break end
                
                local paddedTarget = string.format("%03d", i)
                StatusLabel.Text = "Firing remote: ID " .. paddedTarget
                
                pcall(function()
                    PlayerDataRemote:FireServer("TouchPetCash", paddedTarget)
                end)
            end
            task.wait(0.1)
        end
        StatusLabel.Text = "Idle"
    end)
end


local function tweenColor(instance, targetColor)
    TweenService:Create(instance, TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
        BackgroundColor3 = targetColor
    }):Play()
end

ToggleButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    _G.PetCashToggle = not _G.PetCashToggle
    
    if _G.PetCashToggle then
        ToggleButton.Text = "Auto Collect: ACTIVE"
        tweenColor(ToggleButton, Color3.fromRGB(50, 180, 80)) 
        startLoop()
    else
        ToggleButton.Text = "Auto Collect: OFF"
        tweenColor(ToggleButton, Color3.fromRGB(200, 50, 50)) 
    end
end)


ReplayButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local currentKey = KeyTextBox.Text
    
    if currentKey and currentKey ~= "" then
        pcall(function()
            PlayerDataRemote:FireServer("EquipPetByKey", currentKey)
        end)
        
        local oldText = ReplayButton.Text
        ReplayButton.Text = "FIRED PAYLOAD!"
        local oldColor = ReplayButton.BackgroundColor3
        ReplayButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 180, 80)
        
        task.wait(0.3)
        ReplayButton.Text = oldText
        ReplayButton.BackgroundColor3 = oldColor
    else
        ReplayButton.Text = "❌ ENTER A VALID PET CODE"
        task.delay(1.5, function()
            ReplayButton.Text = "Dupe"
        end)
    end
end)

scripts.script:
-- ========================================================
-- PART 1: Brookhaven Auto Name, Bio & Chat Sender
-- ========================================================
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TextChatService = game:GetService("TextChatService")

local myRPName = "ＡＲＢ ＳＰＡＭＭＥＲ"
local myRPBio = "ＡＲＢ ＳＡ ＰＡＮＧＡ ＮＨＩ ... 🚀"
local chatMsg = "ＡＲＢ ＳＰＡＭＭＥＲ ＬＯＡＤＩＮＧ...........ＭＩＮ ＡＮＤ ＡＲＢ ＯＮ ＴＯＰ 🚀"

local nameEvent = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("RE"):WaitForChild("1RPNam1eTex1t")

local function getRGBColor()
    local hue = (tick() % 3) / 3
    return Color3.fromHSV(hue, 1, 1)
end

-- लोडिंग चैट मैसेज
task.spawn(function()
    task.wait(0.5)
    if TextChatService.ChatVersion == Enum.ChatVersion.TextChatService then
        local generalChannel = TextChatService.TextChannels:FindFirstChild("RBXGeneral")
        if generalChannel then
            generalChannel:SendAsync(chatMsg)
        end
    else
        ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("DefaultChatSystemChatEvents"):WaitForChild("SayMessageRequest"):FireServer(chatMsg, "All")
    end
end)

-- RP Name और Bio केवल एक ही बार सेट होगा
task.spawn(function()
    pcall(function()
        local rgb = getRGBColor()
        nameEvent:FireServer("RolePlayName", myRPName, rgb)
        task.wait(0.1)
        nameEvent:FireServer("RolePlayBio", myRPBio, rgb)
    end)
end)


-- ========================================================
-- PART 2: ARB SPAMMER Rayfield GUI (Movable Panel)
-- ========================================================
local Rayfield = loadstring(game:HttpGet('https://sirius.menu/rayfield'))()

local generalChannel = TextChatService.ChatVersion == Enum.ChatVersion.TextChatService and TextChatService.TextChannels:FindFirstChild("RBXGeneral")
local sayMessageEvent = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("DefaultChatSystemChatEvents") and ReplicatedStorage.DefaultChatSystemChatEvents:FindFirstChild("SayMessageRequest")

local Window = Rayfield:CreateWindow({
   Name = "⚡ ＡＲＢ ＳＰＡＭＭＥＲ VVIP ⚡",
   LoadingTitle = "ＡＲＢ ＳＰＡＭＭＥＲ",
   LoadingSubtitle = "by ADITYA",
   ConfigurationSaving = { Enabled = false }
})

local Tab = Window:CreateTab("Main Controls", 4483345998)

local running = false
local generation = 0
local haterList = {"HATER 1", "HATER 2", "HATER 3", "HATER 4"}
local haterIndex = 1
local speed = 0.8

local messageCount = 0
local borderMode = 1 -- 4 बॉर्डर्स में ऑटो रोटेट होगा

-- 100% चैट-सेफ वर्ड्स की लिस्ट (जो टैग्स नहीं बनते)
local words = {
    "LIGHTNING", "THUNDERSTORM", "OVERLORD", "DOMINATOR", "SPECTRE", "APOCALYPSE", "IMPERATOR",
    "ANNIHILATOR", "JUGGERNAUT", "DESTRUCTOR", "IMMORTAL", "LEVIATHAN", "BERSERKER",
    "TITANIC", "PHANTOM", "SHADOWSTRIKER", "NIGHTMARE", "TEMPEST", "VORTEX", "ECLIPSE",
    "HYPERION", "CELESTIAL", "INFINITE", "ABSOLUTE", "ULTIMATE", "SUPREME", "INVINCIBLE",
    "RAGNAROK", "SOLARSTORM", "GALACTIC", "SUPERNOVA", "AVALANCHE", "HURRICANE",
    "BLIZZARD", "TYPHOON", "COLOSSUS", "EXECUTIONER", "WARLORD", "COMMANDER", "GENESIS",
    "SINGULARITY", "OBLIVION", "EVERLASTING", "MONUMENTAL", "VANGUARD", "SENTINEL",
    "SOVEREIGN", "MONARCH", "EMPEROR", "POWERHOUSE", "ARMAGEDDON", "DEVASTATOR",
    "TERMINATOR", "PREDATOR", "DRAGONLORD", "BEHEMOTH", "KRAKEN", "DREADNOUGHT"
}

-- पीछे वाले डायनेमिक वर्ड्स
local tractorWords = {
    "SYSTEM", "MATRIX", "NETWORK", "ENGINE", "PROTOCOL", "FIREWALL", "TERMINAL",
    "CORE", "GATEWAY", "GRID", "SYNAPSE", "ORBIT", "CYBER", "PULSE", "NEXUS"
}

local function sendChatMessage(msg)
    pcall(function()
        if generalChannel then
            generalChannel:SendAsync(msg)
        elseif sayMessageEvent then
            sayMessageEvent:FireServer(msg, "All")
        end
    end)
end

local function getRandomWord()
    return words[math.random(1, #words)]
end

local function getRandomTractorWord()
    return tractorWords[math.random(1, #tractorWords)]
end

-- नाम और इंडेक्स को अपडेट करने के लिए फिक्स
local function buildFinalMsg()
    local border = ""
    if borderMode == 1 then
        border = string.rep("/////===", 10)
    elseif borderMode == 2 then
        border = string.rep("~~~~~===", 10)
    elseif borderMode == 3 then
        border = string.rep("@_-", 30)
    else
        border = string.rep("/////+++", 10)
    end
    
    local w1 = getRandomWord()
    local w2 = getRandomWord()
    local w3 = getRandomWord()
    local w4 = getRandomWord()
    local t1 = getRandomTractorWord()
    
    local currentHater = haterList[haterIndex]
    if not currentHater or currentHater == "" then
        currentHater = "HATER 1"
    end
    
    haterIndex = (haterIndex % #haterList) + 1
    local cleanName = string.upper(currentHater)
    
    local msg = string.format("%s\n[⚡ %s] TMX ME %s %s ROKET BOOM %s %s TRACTOR %s [MIN AND ARB ON TOP]", border, cleanName, w1, w2, w3, w4, t1)
    
    -- सेफ्टी चेकर: लिमिट क्रॉस होते ही 'TRACTOR' शब्द अपने आप गायब हो जाएगा ताकि चैट में रुकावट न आए
    if #msg > 185 then
        msg = string.format("%s\n[⚡ %s] TMX ME %s %s ROKET BOOM %s %s %s [MIN AND ARB ON TOP]", border, cleanName, w1, w2, w3, w4, t1)
    end
    
    return msg
end

Tab:CreateLabel("✨ ＡＲＢ ＳＰＡＭＭＥＲ ＳＹＳＴＥＭ ✨")
Tab:CreateLabel("👑 MAIN OWNER: MINOWN_ADITYA")
Tab:CreateLabel("🔥 CREATOR: ADITYA")

Tab:CreateInput({
   Name = "HATER 1 Name",
   PlaceholderText = "Enter Name",
   RemoveTextAfterFocusLost = false,
   Callback = function(Value) haterList[1] = Value ~= "" and Value or "HATER 1" end,
})

Tab:CreateInput({
   Name = "HATER 2 Name",
   PlaceholderText = "Enter Name",
   RemoveTextAfterFocusLost = false,
   Callback = function(Value) haterList[2] = Value ~= "" and Value or "HATER 2" end,
})

Tab:CreateInput({
   Name = "HATER 3 Name",
   PlaceholderText = "Enter Name",
   RemoveTextAfterFocusLost = false,
   Callback = function(Value) haterList[3] = Value ~= "" and Value or "HATER 3" end,
})

Tab:CreateInput({
   Name = "HATER 4 Name",
   PlaceholderText = "Enter Name",
   RemoveTextAfterFocusLost = false,
   Callback = function(Value) haterList[4] = Value ~= "" and Value or "HATER 4" end,
})

Tab:CreateSlider({
   Name = "Speed Slider (Seconds)",
   Range = {0.01, 2.0},
   Increment = 0.01,
   Suffix = "sec",
   CurrentValue = 0.8,
   Flag = "SpeedSlider",
   Callback = function(Value) speed = Value end,
})

local preview = Tab:CreateLabel("STATUS: READY")

Tab:CreateToggle({
   Name = "START / STOP SPAMMER",
   CurrentValue = false,
   Flag = "SpammerToggle",
   Callback = function(Value)
        running = Value
        generation = generation + 1
        local currentGeneration = generation
        messageCount = 0
        borderMode = 1
        
        if not running then preview:Set("STATUS: STOPPED") return end
        
        task.spawn(function()
            while running and currentGeneration == generation do
                local msg = buildFinalMsg()
                preview:Set(msg)
                sendChatMessage(msg)
                
                messageCount = messageCount + 1
                
                -- 8 मैसेज के बाद 1.5 सेकंड का कूलडाउन और अगले बॉर्डर पर स्विच
                if messageCount >= 8 then
                    messageCount = 0
                    borderMode = (borderMode % 4) + 1
                    preview:Set("RESTING FOR 1.5 SECONDS...")
                    task.wait(1.5)
                else
                    task.wait(speed)
                end
            end
        end)
   end,
})

Tab:CreateButton({
   Name = "Preview Message",
   Callback = function() preview:Set(buildFinalMsg()) end,
})

scripts.script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

------------------------------------------------
-- LIMPEZA
------------------------------------------------

local oldGui = playerGui:FindFirstChild("SpiderUI")
if oldGui then
	oldGui:Destroy()
end

------------------------------------------------
-- CONFIGURAÇÕES
------------------------------------------------

local SWING_ANIM = "rbxassetid://507767968"
local SWING_SOUND = "rbxassetid://1284846268"
local ZIP_SOUND = "rbxassetid://9084017080"

-- ANIMAÇÃO DE ESCALADA R15
local CLIMB_ANIM = "rbxassetid://507765644"

local swinging = false
local swingStep = 1
local zipStep = 1

local climbing = false
local climbEnabled = false

local swingConn = nil
local swingAnchor = nil
local swingRope = nil
local swingTrack = nil

local climbConn = nil
local climbTrack = nil
local climbVelocity = nil
local climbAlign = nil
local climbAttachment = nil

local webs = {}
local ikList = {}
local gripAtt = nil

------------------------------------------------
-- PERSONAGEM
------------------------------------------------

local function getParts()
	local char = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()

	local hrp = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid")

	return char, hrp, hum
end

local function applyJump(char)
	local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid")

	hum.UseJumpPower = true
	hum.JumpPower = 100
end

if player.Character then
	task.spawn(applyJump, player.Character)
end

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
	task.wait(0.5)
	applyJump(char)
end)

------------------------------------------------
-- ANIMAÇÃO
------------------------------------------------

local function getAnimator(hum)
	local animator = hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")

	if not animator then
		animator = Instance.new("Animator")
		animator.Parent = hum
	end

	return animator
end

------------------------------------------------
-- MÃOS
------------------------------------------------

local function getHand(char, side)

	if side == "Right" then
		return char:FindFirstChild("RightHand")
			or char:FindFirstChild("Right Arm")
	end

	return char:FindFirstChild("LeftHand")
		or char:FindFirstChild("Left Arm")
end

------------------------------------------------
-- BRAÇOS
------------------------------------------------

local function getArmRoot(char, side)

	if side == "Right" then
		return char:FindFirstChild("RightUpperArm")
			or char:FindFirstChild("Right Arm")
			or char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
	end

	return char:FindFirstChild("LeftUpperArm")
		or char:FindFirstChild("Left Arm")
		or char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
end

------------------------------------------------
-- LIMPAR TEIAS
------------------------------------------------

local function clearWebs()

	for _, obj in ipairs(webs) do
		if obj and obj.Parent then
			obj:Destroy()
		end
	end

	table.clear(webs)
end

------------------------------------------------
-- LIMPAR IK
------------------------------------------------

local function clearIK()

	for _, ik in ipairs(ikList) do
		if ik and ik.Parent then
			ik:Destroy()
		end
	end

	table.clear(ikList)
end

------------------------------------------------
-- SOM
------------------------------------------------

local function playSound(hrp, id)

	local sound = Instance.new("Sound")

	sound.SoundId = id
	sound.Volume = 2
	sound.Parent = hrp

	sound:Play()

	Debris:AddItem(sound, 3)
end

------------------------------------------------
-- CRIAR TEIA
------------------------------------------------

local function addWebFromHand(char, targetAtt, side)

	local hand = getHand(char, side)

	if not hand or not targetAtt then
		return
	end

	local handAtt = Instance.new("Attachment")
	handAtt.Name = "WebHandAttachment"
	handAtt.Parent = hand

	local beam = Instance.new("Beam")

	beam.Attachment0 = targetAtt
	beam.Attachment1 = handAtt

	beam.Width0 = 0.18
	beam.Width1 = 0.10

	beam.Color = ColorSequence.new(
		Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
	)

	beam.LightEmission = 1
	beam.FaceCamera = true

	beam.Parent = hand

	table.insert(webs, beam)
	table.insert(webs, handAtt)
end

------------------------------------------------
-- IK DO BRAÇO
------------------------------------------------

local function attachArm(char, hum, side, targetAtt)

	local hand = getHand(char, side)
	local root = getArmRoot(char, side)

	if not hand or not root or not targetAtt then
		return
	end

	local ik = Instance.new("IKControl")

	ik.Name = "WebArmIK_" .. side
	ik.Type = Enum.IKControlType.Position

	ik.EndEffector = hand
	ik.ChainRoot = root
	ik.Target = targetAtt

	ik.Weight = 1
	ik.SmoothTime = 0.08

	ik.Parent = hum

	table.insert(ikList, ik)
end

------------------------------------------------
-- UI
------------------------------------------------

local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")

gui.Name = "SpiderUI"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true

gui.Parent = playerGui

------------------------------------------------
-- BOTÃO DE ESCALAR
------------------------------------------------

local btnClimb = Instance.new("ImageButton")

btnClimb.Name = "BtnClimb"

btnClimb.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(75,75)

btnClimb.Position = UDim2.new(
	0.68,
	0,
	0.57,
	0
)

btnClimb.BackgroundColor3 =
	Color3.fromRGB(190,25,25)

btnClimb.Image =
	"rbxassetid://76038791676557"

btnClimb.ScaleType =
	Enum.ScaleType.Fit

btnClimb.Parent = gui

local climbCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")

climbCorner.CornerRadius =
	UDim.new(1,0)

climbCorner.Parent = btnClimb

local climbStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")

climbStroke.Color =
	Color3.fromRGB(0,110,255)

climbStroke.Thickness = 4

climbStroke.Parent = btnClimb

------------------------------------------------
-- BOTÃO BALANÇO
------------------------------------------------

local btnSwing = Instance.new("ImageButton")

btnSwing.Name = "BtnSwing"

btnSwing.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(75,75)

btnSwing.Position = UDim2.new(
	0.68,
	0,
	0.78,
	0
)

btnSwing.BackgroundColor3 =
	Color3.fromRGB(190,25,25)

btnSwing.Image =
	"rbxassetid://124599639623520"

btnSwing.ScaleType =
	Enum.ScaleType.Fit

btnSwing.Parent = gui

local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")

------------------------------------------------
-- DETECTAR PAREDE
------------------------------------------------

local function getWall()

	local char, hrp = getParts()

	local params = RaycastParams.new()

	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {char}

	params.IgnoreWater = true

	local directions = {
		hrp.CFrame.LookVector,
		-hrp.CFrame.LookVector,
		hrp.CFrame.RightVector,
		-hrp.CFrame.RightVector
	}

	local closestResult = nil
	local closestDistance = math.huge

	for _, direction in ipairs(directions) do

		local result = Workspace:Raycast(
			hrp.Position,
			direction * 3.5,
			params
		)

		if result then

			local distance =
				(result.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude

			if distance < closestDistance then
				closestDistance = distance
				closestResult = result
			end
		end
	end

	return closestResult
end

------------------------------------------------
-- PARAR ESCALADA
------------------------------------------------

local function stopClimb()

	if not climbing then
		return
	end

	climbing = false

	if climbConn then
		climbConn:Disconnect()
		climbConn = nil
	end

	if climbTrack then
		if climbTrack.IsPlaying then
			climbTrack:Stop(0.15)
		end

		climbTrack = nil
	end

	if climbVelocity then
		climbVelocity:Destroy()
		climbVelocity = nil
	end

	if climbAlign then
		climbAlign:Destroy()
		climbAlign = nil
	end

	if climbAttachment then
		climbAttachment:Destroy()
		climbAttachment = nil
	end

	local char, hrp, hum = getParts()

	hum.AutoRotate = true
	hum.PlatformStand = false

	hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
end

------------------------------------------------
-- COMEÇAR ESCALADA
------------------------------------------------

local function startClimb()

	if climbing or not climbEnabled then
		return
	end

	local char, hrp, hum = getParts()

	local wall = getWall()

	if not wall then
		return
	end

	climbing = true

	hum.AutoRotate = false
	hum.PlatformStand = false

	------------------------------------------------
	-- ANIMAÇÃO DE ESCALADA R15
	------------------------------------------------

	local animator = getAnimator(hum)

	local anim = Instance.new("Animation")

	anim.AnimationId =
		CLIMB_ANIM

	climbTrack =
		animator:LoadAnimation(anim)

	climbTrack.Priority =
		Enum.AnimationPriority.Action4

	climbTrack.Looped = true

	climbTrack:Play(0.1)

	-- FORÇA O HUMANOID PARA O ESTADO DE ESCALADA
	hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing)

	------------------------------------------------
	-- CONTROLE DE VELOCIDADE
	------------------------------------------------

	climbAttachment =
		Instance.new("Attachment")

	climbAttachment.Name =
		"SpiderClimbAttachment"

	climbAttachment.Parent = hrp

	climbVelocity =
		Instance.new("LinearVelocity")

	climbVelocity.Name =
		"SpiderClimbVelocity"

	climbVelocity.MaxForce =
		math.huge

	climbVelocity.RelativeTo =
		Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World

	climbVelocity.VectorVelocity =
		Vector3.zero

	climbVelocity.Attachment0 =
		climbAttachment

	climbVelocity.Parent = hrp

	------------------------------------------------
	-- ORIENTAÇÃO
	------------------------------------------------

	climbAlign =
		Instance.new("AlignOrientation")

	climbAlign.Name =
		"SpiderClimbOrientation"

	climbAlign.Mode =
		Enum.OrientationAlignmentMode.OneAttachment

	climbAlign.MaxTorque =
		math.huge

	climbAlign.Responsiveness =
		25

	climbAlign.RigidityEnabled =
		false

	climbAlign.Attachment0 =
		climbAttachment

	climbAlign.Parent = hrp

	------------------------------------------------
	-- CONTROLE
	------------------------------------------------

	climbConn =
		RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()

			if not climbing then
				return
			end

			if not hrp.Parent then
				stopClimb()
				return
			end

			local currentWall = getWall()

			if not currentWall then
				stopClimb()
				return
			end

			local normal =
				currentWall.Normal

			------------------------------------------------
			-- CÂMERA
			------------------------------------------------

			local camera =
				Workspace.CurrentCamera

			local cameraForward =
				camera.CFrame.LookVector

			local cameraRight =
				camera.CFrame.RightVector

			------------------------------------------------
			-- MOVIMENTO DO JOYSTICK
			------------------------------------------------

			local move =
				hum.MoveDirection

			local horizontal =
				Vector3.new(
					move.X,
					0,
					move.Z
				)

			local vertical =
				0

			if horizontal.Magnitude > 0.05 then

				local forwardAmount =
					horizontal:Dot(cameraForward)

				vertical =
					forwardAmount
			end

			------------------------------------------------
			-- MOVIMENTO NA PAREDE
			------------------------------------------------

			local up =
				Vector3.new(0,1,0)

			local wallRight =
				cameraRight

			wallRight =
				wallRight
				- normal * wallRight:Dot(normal)

			if wallRight.Magnitude > 0.01 then
				wallRight =
					wallRight.Unit
			end

			local climbUp =
				up * vertical * 8

			local climbSide =
				wallRight
				* move:Dot(wallRight)
				* 8

			local velocity =
				climbUp + climbSide

			------------------------------------------------
			-- MANTER NO PAREDÃO
			------------------------------------------------

			velocity +=
				-normal * 3

			climbVelocity.VectorVelocity =
				velocity

			------------------------------------------------
			-- VIRAR PARA A PAREDE
			------------------------------------------------

			local facing =
				-normal

			local look =
				Vector3.new(
					facing.X,
					0,
					facing.Z
				)

			if look.Magnitude > 0.01 then

				climbAlign.CFrame =
					CFrame.lookAt(
						Vector3.zero,
						look.Unit
					)
			end

			------------------------------------------------
			-- MANTER ESTADO DE ESCALADA
			------------------------------------------------

			if hum:GetState() ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing then
				hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing)
			end
		end)
end

------------------------------------------------
-- BOTÃO DE ESCALADA
------------------------------------------------

btnClimb.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()

	climbEnabled =
		not climbEnabled

	if climbEnabled then

		local wall = getWall()

		if wall then
			startClimb()
		end

	else

		stopClimb()

	end
end)

------------------------------------------------
-- PARAR BALANÇO
------------------------------------------------

local function stopSwing()

	if not swinging then
		return
	end

	swinging = false

	if swingConn then
		swingConn:Disconnect()
		swingConn = nil
	end

	if swingTrack then
		if swingTrack.IsPlaying then
			swingTrack:Stop(0.2)
		end
	end

	clearIK()
	clearWebs()

	local char, hrp, hum = getParts()

	hum.PlatformStand = false
	hum.JumpPower = 100

	if swingRope then
		swingRope:Destroy()
		swingRope = nil
	end

	if swingAnchor then
		swingAnchor:Destroy()
		swingAnchor = nil
	end

	gripAtt = nil

	swingStep += 1

	if swingStep > 3 then
		swingStep = 1
	end
end

------------------------------------------------
-- COMEÇAR BALANÇO
------------------------------------------------

local function startSwing()

	if swinging then
		return
	end

	swinging = true

	local char, hrp, hum = getParts()

	hum.PlatformStand = true

	local animator = getAnimator(hum)

	if not swingTrack then

		local anim = Instance.new("Animation")

		anim.AnimationId = SWING_ANIM

		swingTrack =
			animator:LoadAnimation(anim)

		swingTrack.Priority =
			Enum.AnimationPriority.Action

		swingTrack.Looped = true
	end

	swingTrack:Play(0.15)

	playSound(hrp, SWING_SOUND)

	------------------------------------------------
	-- PONTO DA TEIA
	------------------------------------------------

	swingAnchor = Instance.new("Part")

	swingAnchor.Name = "WebAnchor"

	swingAnchor.Anchored = true
	swingAnchor.CanCollide = false
	swingAnchor.Transparency = 1

	swingAnchor.Size =
		Vector3.new(0.2,0.2,0.2)

	swingAnchor.Position =
		hrp.Position
		+ hrp.CFrame.LookVector * 36
		+ Vector3.new(0,13,0)

	swingAnchor.Parent = Workspace

	local a0 =
		Instance.new("Attachment")

	a0.Parent = swingAnchor

	local a1 =
		Instance.new("Attachment")

	a1.Parent = hrp

	swingRope =
		Instance.new("RopeConstraint")

	swingRope.Attachment0 = a0
	swingRope.Attachment1 = a1

	swingRope.Length =
		(swingAnchor.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude

	swingRope.Visible = false

	swingRope.Parent = hrp

	if swingStep == 1 then

		addWebFromHand(char,a0,"Right")
		attachArm(char,hum,"Right",a0)

	elseif swingStep == 2 then

		addWebFromHand(char,a0,"Left")
		attachArm(char,hum,"Left",a0)

	else

		addWebFromHand(char,a0,"Right")
		addWebFromHand(char,a0,"Left")

		attachArm(char,hum,"Right",a0)
		attachArm(char,hum,"Left",a0)

	end

	hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity +=
		hrp.CFrame.LookVector * 48

	swingConn =
		RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()

			if not swinging then
				return
			end

			if not hrp.Parent or not swingAnchor.Parent then
				return
			end

			local offset =
				swingAnchor.Position - hrp.Position

			if offset.Magnitude < 0.1 then
				return
			end

			local dir =
				offset.Unit

			local vel =
				hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity

			local radial =
				dir * vel:Dot(dir)

			hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity =
				(vel - radial)
				+ Vector3.new(
					0,
					-Workspace.Gravity * 0.03,
					0
				)
		end)
end

------------------------------------------------
-- WEB ZIP
------------------------------------------------

btnZip.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()

	stopSwing()

	local char, hrp, hum = getParts()

	local sides

	if zipStep == 1 then
		sides = {"Right"}

	elseif zipStep == 2 then
		sides = {"Left"}

	else
		sides = {"Right","Left"}
	end

	local tip = Instance.new("Part")

	tip.Name = "WebZipTarget"

	tip.Anchored = true
	tip.CanCollide = false
	tip.Transparency = 1

	tip.Size =
		Vector3.new(0.2,0.2,0.2)

	tip.Position =
		hrp.Position
		+ hrp.CFrame.LookVector * 34
		+ Vector3.new(0,12,0)

	tip.Parent = Workspace

	local tipAtt =
		Instance.new("Attachment")

	tipAtt.Parent = tip

	for _, side in ipairs(sides) do

		addWebFromHand(
			char,
			tipAtt,
			side
		)

		attachArm(
			char,
			hum,
			side,
			tipAtt
		)
	end

	playSound(hrp, ZIP_SOUND)

	local push =
		Instance.new("BodyVelocity")

	push.MaxForce =
		Vector3.new(
			1e7,
			1e7,
			1e7
		)

	push.Velocity =
		hrp.CFrame.LookVector * 120
		+ Vector3.new(0,55,0)

	push.Parent = hrp

	Debris:AddItem(tip,0.32)
	Debris:AddItem(push,0.28)

	task.delay(0.32,function()

		clearWebs()
		clearIK()

	end)

	zipStep += 1

	if zipStep > 3 then
		zipStep = 1
	end
end)

------------------------------------------------
-- CONTROLES
------------------------------------------------

btnSwing.MouseButton1Down:Connect(
	startSwing
)

btnSwing.MouseButton1Up:Connect(
	stopSwing
)

btnSwing.MouseLeave:Connect(
	stopSwing
)

------------------------------------------------

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()

	if swinging then
		stopSwing()
	end

	if climbing then
		stopClimb()
	end

	climbEnabled = false

	swingStep = 1
	zipStep = 1

end)
